title: Spammy repetitive adding/removal of ext_resource uids in .tscn files
body:
### Tested versions

- Repro in 4.4-stable and 4.4.1-stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - macOS Ventura (13.7.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads)

### Issue description

While I work in 4.4 and 4.4.1, Godot will change one or more `.tscn` files to delete the `uid="..."` attribute in one or more `[ext_resource]` tags.  I ignore it as spam and commit it along with my other changes to the files.  Then later I'll find Godot has changed the `.tscn` file again, to re-introduce a `uid="..."` attribute.

As an example: `git log -p -- 'ship/ship.tscn'` shows a uid added to the `gravitational_body.gd` resource when I upgraded to 4.4, then the uid stripped off during a random commit, then re-added 2 commits later.

```

 [sub_resource type="RectangleShape2D" id="RectangleShape2D_0yg0q"]
 size = Vector2(32, 53)
```




### Steps to reproduce

Sorry, I am not sure how to cause it to happen, but it happens frequently, to the point that I can't tell what changes I've made to `.tscn` files because they're so spammy.  I'm happy to run any tests you'd like to try to isolate the problem.

I notice that it happens to the `[ext_resource path="res://health_tracker.gd"]` tag, and `health_tracker.gd` is not a `@tool` script.  So I don't think it's a script in the external resource triggering the change.  I've also seen it happen in `base_projectile.tscn`, and `base_projectile.gd` is not a `@tool` script, so it would appear `@tool` scripts are not involved.
